name: Ben Thanh Market
desc: The clock-tower market where all of Saigon haggles. Browse like you're rich, snack like you're smart.

name: War Remnants Museum
desc: Heavy, necessary, unforgettable — and it costs about as much as an iced coffee.

name: Independence Palace
desc: A 1960s time capsule with war rooms in the basement and a helicopter parked on the roof.

name: Saigon Central Post Office
desc: A honey-colored colonial hall where you can still mail a someday-postcard to future you.

name: Jade Emperor Pagoda
desc: A smoke-dark pagoda full of carved gods and resident turtles. Quietly one of the city's best free wonders.

name: Nguyen Hue Walking Street
desc: Saigon's living room after dark — fountains, skate kids, and everyone out chasing the evening breeze.

name: Bitexco Saigon Skydeck
desc: The lotus-shaped tower with the helipad ledge. One ticket buys the whole motorbike galaxy swirling below.

name: Thien Hau Temple
desc: Cholon's sea-goddess temple under a slow rain of incense coils. Wishes hang from the ceiling, literally.

name: Landmark 81 SkyView
desc: Vietnam's tallest tower — pure someday-list material. Even from the riverside park it steals the skyline.

name: Tao Dan Park
desc: Old trees, dawn tai chi, and the famous morning corner where uncles bring their songbirds to brunch.
